notes: F[j, P, T, phi] = mean over prompts of language P, then over CoT tokens, then over the layers in phase phi, of the indicator that the top-1 logit-lens predicted token belongs to target language T at checkpoint j. G[j, P, T, ll_idx] = mean over prompts of language P, then over CoT tokens, of the same indicator at the single layer last_layers[ll_idx]. Punctuation, special tokens, and tokens outside the seven studied languages contribute zero to every target in both F and G.
